description:
You are an IT Relocation Specialist verifying internet infrastructure for remote workers. Use the official FCC National Broadband Map (https://broadbandmap.fcc.gov/home) to determine the best available WIRED broadband options for three specific public library locations.

For each of the following addresses, identify the fastest available WIRED provider (Fiber, Cable, or Copper/DSL). Ignore Satellite and Fixed Wireless providers.

Target Addresses:
1. Seattle Central Library: 1000 4th Ave, Seattle, WA 98104
2. Austin Central Library: 710 W Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78701
3. Portland Public Library: 5 Monument Sq, Portland, ME 04101

Deliverables:
1. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'ISP Research' containing a link to the broadband map.
2. Create a JSON report at '~/Documents/isp_availability_report.json' with the following structure for each city:

{
  "seattle_wa": {
    "address": "1000 4th Ave, Seattle, WA 98104",
    "fastest_provider": "...",
    "technology": "...",
    "max_download_mbps": 1000,
    "max_upload_mbps": 1000
  },
  "austin_tx": { ... },
  "portland_me": { ... }
}

Ensure the technology listed is strictly Wired (Fiber, Cable, or DSL).
